name: inventory_constraints
preconditionSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.schema_migrations WHERE version = '0014') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_inventory_movements') AS ok;
verificationSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_inventory_movements' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_inventory_stock_positions' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_serial_numbers__variant_serial' AND contype = 'u') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_batches__variant_batch' AND contype = 'u') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_stock_transfers__branch_document' AND contype = 'u') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_stocktake_sessions__branch_document' AND contype = 'u') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_inventory_adjustments__branch_document' AND contype = 'u') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_inventory_movements__warehouse_branch' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_stock_transfers__from_warehouse_branch' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_stocktake_sessions__warehouse_branch' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_inventory_adjustments__warehouse_branch' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'ck_stock_reservations__status' AND contype = 'c') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'ck_stocktake_sessions__status' AND contype = 'c') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'ck_stocktake_lines__difference_exact' AND contype = 'c') AS ok;
recovery: Transactional failure rolls the migration back. After successful production apply, recovery is forward-only: preserve Inventory history and issue a corrective migration rather than dropping integrity constraints or rewriting committed migration history. The active-reservation partial unique rule and all independent Inventory query/performance indexes remain deferred to Phase 03.07; Sales-owned reservation document FKs remain deferred to the Sales constraint slice.
